newsitem.title: FRANCE: French judge targets Algerian Moslem arms ring.
newsitem.headline: French judge targets Algerian Moslem arms ring.

text.p: Three Algerian-born men suspected of suppling Algerian Moslem fundamentalists with weapons have been placed under investigation and ordered held by France's chief anti-terrorism investigator, justice sources said.
The sources said on Monday that Judge Jean-Louis Bruguiere ordered the three held in preventive custody on suspicion of criminal conspiracy with a terrorist objective.
The sources named them as Nasser Mamache, who was detained in Nice, Mohamed Nouazli, and Brahim Souizi, both detained in Marseille.
Three other individuals were placed under investigation in the same probe on Saturday. The six are suspected of convoying weapons by car towards Algeria.
Moslem insurgents launched a civil war after the army intervened in 1992 to cancel a general election which the Islamic Salvation Front (FIS) had been poised to win.
